notes.title: Server Stability & Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Overview

Backend optimizations to reduce latency and timeouts.

Increased server capacity during peak hours.

Improvements

Matchmaking more consistent under high load.

Faster lobby creation and region routing.

Bug Fixes

Resolved occasional login failures.

Fixed rare crash when rejoining sessions.

UI overlap in settings screen corrected.

How to Update

Restart Steam to download the latest build.

If issues persist, verify game files via Steam.

Known Issues

A small number of users may still see long queue times in certain regions. We’re monitoring.

Thank you for your reports and patience!

notes.title: Mega Racer: Quantum Rush Demo Hotfix Update Notice
notes.content:
Update Date: February 27, 2025
Version: 0.0.3
Key Update: Bug Fixes

1. Bug Fixes
 - Fixed an issue where sounds could still be heard even when other karts were far away.
 - Fixed an issue where race records were not applied intermittently.
 - Fixed an issue where the same button could be pressed multiple times unintentionally.
 - Adjusted the size and position of certain UI elements.

notes.title: Mega Racer Quantum Rush Demo Hotfix Update Notice
notes.content:
Update Date: February 25, 2025
Version: 0.0.2
Key Updates: World map improvements, mode difficulty adjustments, bug fixes

1. World Map Improvements
Added visibility of other players' locations within the same world.
When zooming out on the world map, area names will now be displayed.

2. Mode Difficulty Adjustments
In Reverse Slalom Mode, the difficulty of certain points has been slightly reduced.

3. Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where some pop-ups were positioned in a way that made them difficult to click.
Fixed an issue where certain roads had unintended holes.
Fixed an issue where the icon in Dribble Mode was displayed incorrectly.
